answer: Require every trading agent to lock a cedar-pegged stake bond before entering the marketplace: an attacker minting 10,000 sock puppets must post 10,000 bonds, turning sybil farming from free to capital-intensive. Add a reputation pigment that only darkens through weeks of completed work, so fresh identities start pale and untrusted. Grow the garden of trust with vouched introductions: endorsers lose their own stake if their referral misbehaves. Combined cost—locked capital, time, social liability—is what a sybil army cannot cheaply replicate.
